answer.reason: The verses tell three distinct events of Shimei the son of Gera: his cursing of David, his pardon, and his death under Solomon.

clauses.english: cursed King David and threw stones at him as he passed Bahurim
fell down before David and begged forgiveness, and was spared by the king's oath
clauses.quote: Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

clauses.english: was put to death by Solomon's order after leaving Jerusalem for Gath
clauses.quote: went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants

doubts: 1KI 1:8 names a Shimei who was not with Adonijah; it may be another man of the same name, so it was left out.
